changes: Round 13: new brawler build (the existing Sushi Chef is grapple into Power Slash spirit) — style sources: tracklock pro Yamato last 30 days, a gun/melee item set (no Power Slash spirit items besides Spirit Snatch) (503 games, 61.4% WR: Restorative Shot 97%, Stalker 97%, Melee Lifesteal 92%, Radiant 72%, Close Quarters 70%, Mystic Regen 64%; mid Lifestrike 87%, Bullet Resist Shredder 86%, Hunter's Aura 75%, Recharging Rush 70%, Healing Booster 67%, Extra Regen 54%; late Express Shot 56%, Berserker 47%, Melee Charge 45%, HV 37%, Crushing Fists 27%, Colossus 25%, Refresher 19%), lockbuilds 'SwoleBenji Melee Tank Brawler', 'wander gunmato'. Flying Slash gets 2 charges at T3 (point 7 in this order), so Recharging Rush has a charge to refill. Restorative Shot and Close Quarters are bought first and sold for Express Shot and Crushing Fists. Order: seemeta most popular (63.4%, 8,182 matches) 3221242333444111, Power Slash upgraded last, which suits a build that doesn't use it.

Round 14: desc 'Gun and melee Yamato'; Extra Health lane note emptied (it becomes core Colossus, so 'sell it' was wrong); Refresher now sells Recharging Rush (same job, every charge back) instead of Colossus; Reactive Barrier note no longer claims hooks; Counterspell note fixed; duplicate sell notes removed. Item set re-sourced from mobalytics Yamato build-stats Flying-Slash-maxed-first view (23.5K matches).
Round 15: Divine Barrier added to the rich box with 'If you bought Dispel Magic, sell it for this.' (Dispel Magic is in Counters; Kieran's layout rule).
Round 17: Dispel Magic note 'Hexes and slows stop you getting in.' (Yamato has no grapple). Desc 'Brawler Yamato' to match the name. Lane Extra Health gets 'Sell it once you're out of slots.'.

Round 20: Mystic Regeneration → Radiant Regeneration replaced by Grit → Reactive Barrier (Yamato isn't a many-cast hero); counter Reactive Barrier → Unstoppable. Late list Indomitable, Witchmail, Leech, Refresher, Cheat Death; core+late 73.6k.
Round 23: kit re-read, no item change (see log).
Round 25: ability order 3221242333444111 -> 3321243324412411 (worked out from the kit for this build's playstyle).
Cost pass: Melee Charge moved to the start of Mid (was bought after 9.6k of gun items); Leech now sells Hunter's Aura instead of Bullet Resist Shredder.
